behavior.partial: Reject when a required aggregate or snapshot field is missing.
behavior.stale: Retain the immutable snapshot month in eligibility; consumers decide display freshness.
behavior.malformed: Reject deterministically with sorted issue strings and no source-value echo.
behavior.reordered: Accept object keys and scenario rows in any order; duplicate scenario IDs are rejected.
behavior.prohibited: Reject identifiers, credentials, prompts, provider account IDs, employee records, and raw customer data before comparison.
